company.name: Get Energy
company.shortDescription: Global Energy Mobile Platform for charge your gadgets
company.description: Get Energy operates in the power bank sharing industry, offering charging stations for mobile device users. The company runs through partnerships and user fees, using a platform for station management, monitoring, and payments across multiple locations.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile platform that allows users to rent portable powerbanks via an app or QR code, charge their devices, and return the powerbanks at any station within the network.
productsAndServices.name: Get Energy Powerbank Sharing Service

productsAndServices.description: A plug-and-play platform for partners to deploy and manage powerbank sharing stations, including hardware integration, user app access, and payment processing.
productsAndServices.name: Get Energy Partner Platform
